prompt: Which booking meets both visitors’ needs and their departure time?
promptZh: 哪個預約安排同時符合兩位訪客的需求和離開時間？

options.text: Add the orientation tour and reserve seats 6 and 7 at 2:40.
options.zh: 加選場地導覽，以及預約 2:40 場的 6、7 號座位。
options.whyZh: 1:35 能趕到導覽，2:40 有相鄰座且入場開燈，25 分鐘放映在 3:05 結束。

options.text: Add the tour and reserve the two remaining seats at 2:00.
options.zh: 加選導覽，以及預約 2:00 場剩下兩席。
options.whyZh: 能趕上導覽和公車，但座位不相鄰，且 2:00 場入場前調暗。

options.text: Reserve two adjacent seats at 3:20 and add the tour.
options.zh: 預約 3:20 場兩個相鄰座位，再加選導覽。
options.whyZh: 座位可相鄰但入場不開燈，而且開始時已過 3:10。

options.text: Reserve only one seat at 2:40 and ask Pema to wait for a walk-in seat next to it.
options.zh: 2:40 場只先訂一席，請佩瑪等該座旁的現場候補位。
options.whyZh: 想並坐就須同時預約兩個相鄰座位；候補不能保證相鄰。

explanationZh: 1:35 能趕到導覽，2:40 有相鄰座且入場開燈，25 分鐘放映在 3:05 結束。
evidence: you must reserve two adjacent seats. / 2:40 City Winter Sky | 25 minutes | lights on for entry / Seats 6 and 7 together are still free at 2:40 / We want to sit together and she needs the lights up while we find the seats. / We need to be outside the dome by 3:10 for our bus. Pema wants to try the raised-line floor plan but won’t be back at the library next week.
